_comment: Cross-language parity vectors for internal/integrations/github, the GitHub
integration's in-process MCP server. Generated from Go, then frozen. Read by
what Go produces, so a divergence fails one language against the other's real
output rather than against a belief about it.
'tools' and 'hosting' come from live tools/list calls against servers built by
github.Start; 'calls' come from live tools/call calls against a scripted fake
GitHub that records the request each tool built.
'token' is a fixture, not a secret: it is recorded so the Bearer prefix is pinned.

tools.name: create_issue
tools.description: Creates a new issue in a repository.

tools.name: create_pull
tools.description: Creates a new pull request.

tools.name: create_release
tools.description: Creates a new release in a repository.

tools.description: Gets details of a specific issue by number.

tools.name: get_pull

hosting.case: every service enabled, no tool lists — an empty allowed set hosts everything
a disabled service contributes neither its gate nor its tools
a non-empty allowed set is a filter across every enabled service
the allowed set is a union over services, not a per-service list
a tool named by a disabled service is not allowed anywhere

calls.case: list_repos/zero values take the default page size and omit page
list_repos/every filter set, and per_page over 100 falls back to 30
list_repos/per_page 100 is the largest value that survives the clamp
list_repos/a negative per_page is a zero, not an error
get_repo/a space and a slash in the segments, PathEscape'd
get_repo/the reserved bytes a segment keeps, the ones it escapes, and UTF-8
get_repo/a non-2xx status is the API's own body, verbatim
get_repo/a 500 with an empty body still names the status
search_code/QueryEscape, where a space is + and a tilde is not escaped
list_issues/every filter, and the sorted query Values.Encode produces
list_issues/empty filters drop out of the query entirely
get_issue/the number is formatted with %d, not escaped
create_issue/a full body, whose keys json.Marshal sorts
create_issue/only the required title reaches the body
create_issue/a labels string of only separators is a null, not an empty array
update_issue/every field set
update_issue/an empty update still sends a body, and it is {}
list_pulls/every filter
get_pull/the same %d path shape as get_issue
create_pull/draft true adds the key; the three required fields are unconditional
create_pull/draft false omits the key entirely
get_pull_diff/a non-JSON body under a caller-chosen Accept
calls.text:
Diff:
diff --git a/x b/x
--- a/x
+++ b/x
@@ -1 +1 @@
-a
+b

calls.case: get_pull_diff/callRaw reports a non-2xx exactly as call does
calls.text: github API error: status 406: {"message":"Unsupported media type"}

calls.case: list_pull_comments/no filters at all beyond paging
list_workflows/paging only
list_workflow_runs/no workflow_id takes the repository-wide path
list_workflow_runs/a workflow_id takes the per-workflow path and is PathEscape'd
trigger_workflow/inputs parse into a map[string]string and are sorted
trigger_workflow/no inputs at all sends only the ref
trigger_workflow/a literal null parses to a nil map and is sent as null
trigger_workflow/an array is not a JSON object
calls.text: parsing workflow inputs (must be a JSON object): json: cannot unmarshal array into Go value of type map[string]string

calls.case: trigger_workflow/a non-string value is not a map[string]string
calls.text: parsing workflow inputs (must be a JSON object): json: cannot unmarshal number into Go value of type string

calls.case: trigger_workflow/a syntactically invalid payload — the one divergence
calls.text: parsing workflow inputs (must be a JSON object): invalid character 'o' in literal null (expecting 'u')
calls.rust_text: parsing workflow inputs (must be a JSON object): expected ident at line 1 column 2

calls.case: trigger_workflow/a truncated payload ends the same way in both languages
calls.text: parsing workflow inputs (must be a JSON object): unexpected end of JSON input

calls.case: get_workflow_run/a run id inside float64's exact range
get_workflow_run/a run id above 2^53 — the Go SDK rounds it, Rust does not
get_run_logs/a 302 with a Location is the answer
get_run_logs/a 301 is a redirect too
calls.text: Logs download URL (time-limited zip archive): https://objects.example.invalid/logs.zip

calls.case: get_run_logs/a 302 with no Location is its own sentence
calls.text: fetching logs URL for run 42: redirect response missing Location header

calls.case: get_run_logs/a non-redirect body is truncated at 512 bytes
calls.text: fetching logs URL for run 42: github API error: status 500: {"message":"

calls.case: list_releases/paging only
create_release/every optional key present
create_release/false booleans omit their keys
list_tags/paging only
list_repos/a zero-fraction float is an integer to Go and not to serde
calls.rust_text: failed to deserialize parameters: invalid type: floating point `30.0`, expected i64

calls.case: get_repo/dot segments are sent literally, not resolved
get_repo/a single dot segment is sent literally too
create_issue/dot segments reach the write path too
get_pull_diff/callRaw builds its own URL, and it is not resolved either
get_run_logs/getRedirectURL builds the third URL, and it is not resolved either
